phase: BNR Prudential Table Source Enumeration and Materialisation Preregistration
purpose: Preregister a definitionally matched BNR-population source path for quarterly total-capital and NPL controls before any values are extracted or inspected for model use. The contract separates source enumeration, byte retention, semantic review and deterministic table extraction; no stage authorizes credit-response estimation.

source_family.publication: Monthly Bulletin / Statistical Section / 11. Banking risk indicators / 11.1 Main prudential indicators
source_family.population: Banks that are Romanian legal entities.
source_family.population_requirement: The source or frozen layout-family evidence must preserve the BNR footnote that the indicators cover only banks that are Romanian legal entities. Foreign-bank branches may not be silently added.

regulatory_breaks.framework: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 680/2014 supervisory reporting

target_window.reason: Starts after the June-2014 supervisory-reporting break and ends at the last complete calendar year before this preregistration. Extension beyond 2025-Q4 requires a new frozen source vintage, not silent append.

total_capital_ratio.canonical_label_ro: Rata fondurilor proprii totale (fostul indicator de solvabilitate)
total_capital_ratio.intended_model_role: Endogenous prudential capital/solvency state candidate; not an exogenous credit-supply shock.

npl_ratio.canonical_label_ro: Rata creditelor neperformante potrivit definiției ABE
npl_ratio.intended_model_role: Endogenous credit-risk state candidate; not an exogenous credit-supply shock.

cet1_ratio_crosscheck.canonical_label_ro: Rata fondurilor proprii de nivel 1 de bază
cet1_ratio_crosscheck.intended_model_role: Semantic/control-family crosscheck only. It may not replace total capital ratio after outcomes are seen.

pilot_structure_evidence.role: Official BNR Monthly Bulletin layout-family evidence only; not a canonical value source until byte-retained under this contract.

source_enumeration_rules.selection_precedence: For each target quarter select the latest official BNR Monthly Bulletin, as of the frozen source-enumeration date, that explicitly reports that quarter and still exposes the target table. Selection is based only on publication/revision precedence and source semantics, never on numerical fit.

extraction_rules.extraction_method: Deterministic PDF text/table extraction from retained official BNR PDF bytes.
extraction_rules.quarter_mapping_rule: Only explicit March/June/September/December rows or exact annual December rows may map to Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4. A yearly summary may map only to Q4 when the publication methodology explicitly identifies annual data as December/end-period.
extraction_rules.provisional_marker_policy: Retain provisional/revised markers as provenance metadata. Never strip a marker silently.
extraction_rules.missing_symbol_policy: x, ellipsis, confidentiality markers or blank cells remain missing/non-applicable according to the publication legend; never convert them to zero.
extraction_rules.decimal_policy: Preserve published decimal precision; no smoothing, interpolation or residual reconstruction.
extraction_rules.duplicate_quarter_policy: If more than one retained publication reports a quarter, only the preregistered source-precedence winner enters the candidate series; all alternatives remain provenance evidence.
